about: Figure questions for bench/grading/scripts/question_figures.py (2026-11-23). Each figure is drawn by the script; the description is the short alt text a teacher would write, without the figure's details. Gold is each item's share (0, 0.5, 1), labelled by Claude from the figure as drawn.

questions.text: Figure 1 shows the rainfall in a town over six months. Which month had the highest rainfall, and by how much did it exceed the month with the lowest rainfall?

items.text: Names the month with the highest rainfall in Figure 1
Gives the difference between the highest and lowest months, read from Figure 1 (within 5 mm)

answers.text: July had the most rain. It was 140 mm and the lowest was March with 20 mm, so July had 120 mm more.
March had the highest rainfall, about 80 mm more than July.

questions.description: Diagram of a plant cell with three labelled structures
questions.text: Name the structure labelled B in Figure 1 and give its function.

items.text: Gives the function of that structure

answers.text: B is the nucleus. It controls the cell's activities and holds the DNA.
B is the vacuole, which stores cell sap.

questions.text: Use Figure 1 to find the speed of the cyclist during the first 10 seconds. Show your working.

items.text: Divides the distance at 10 s by 10 s, the distance read correctly from Figure 1
Correct speed for the first 10 s from Figure 1 (within 0.5 m/s)

answers.text: speed = distance / time = 50 m / 10 s = 5 m/s

questions.text: Calculate the mean of the three current readings in Figure 1.

items.text: Correct mean of the three readings in Figure 1, to 1 decimal place

questions.description: Pie chart of a country's electricity sources
questions.text: Which source in Figure 1 provides about a quarter of the country's electricity?

items.text: Names the source with about 25% in Figure 1

answers.text: Gas, which is about a quarter.

questions.text: Name a primary consumer in Figure 1 and the organism it feeds on.

items.text: Names an animal in Figure 1 that feeds only on a producer
Names the producer that animal feeds on, as the arrows in Figure 1 show

answers.text: The rabbit is a primary consumer; it eats the grass.
The fox, which eats the rabbit.

questions.description: A triangle with two angles marked and one angle x
questions.text: Find the size of angle x in Figure 1. Give a reason for your answer.

items.text: Uses the two angles given in Figure 1 with the angle sum of a triangle (180 degrees)

answers.text: x = 180 - 50 - 60 = 70 degrees, because the angles in a triangle add up to 180.
x = 180 - 50 - 30 = 100 degrees, because the angles in a triangle add up to 180.
